kylecafe_guard.text: Welcome to Kyle Station Cafe. Trains in, tea out, that is the whole system.
The railway from Inverness reached Kyle of Lochalsh in 1897. It is famous as one of the most beautiful rail journeys in Britain.
The line crosses bogs, lochs and glens full of deer. Wave at the deer. They never wave back.
Tha an t-acras orm, I'm hungry, is the most useful sentence in this building. The second is a bheil tì agad, have you tea. We have.
